From: Asha Reddy <a.reddy@finbridge.com>

Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: VM snapshot + 48-hour CVE closure pledge for SOC2 review

Diego,

As part of our SOC2 evidence collection we need a recent vulnerability scan snapshot covering the last 30 days and an attestation of your CVE remediation tempo. Specifically: 1) an exported scan snapshot (CSV) showing current open findings by severity and last scan timestamp; 2) a short statement that describes your SLA for remediation by severity (Critical / High / Medium) and the operational owner(s) who will be responsible for driving fixes; and 3) whether you will commit to a 48-hour initial mitigation/response for critical CVEs discovered in production during the audit window.

Can you provide those artifacts and an attestation by EOD tomorrow our time? We are trying to close the evidence packet for our audit next week.

Attachments we expect: scan snapshot CSV, SOC2 extract for vulnerability controls, and the remediation plan or owner list.

Thanks,
Asha Reddy
Senior InfoSec Manager, FinBridge
asha.reddy@finbridge.com
+1-415-555-0192

Asha — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We can provide the artifacts and a formal attestation. High level commitments below; I'll follow up with the actual files attached to this thread within the hour and an attestation signed by our Security lead.

Quick summary of commitments (will include in attestation):
- Scan snapshot: attached (scan_snapshot-20260701.csv) — includes host/component, finding id, CVE, severity, first seen, last scanned.
- SOC2 extract: attached (soc2-extract-redwood.pdf) — excerpted controls relating to vulnerability mgmt and patch verification.
- Remediation tempo: For production-critical CVEs we commit to an initial response within 48 hours and an owner assignment; full remediation cadence: Critical = 48 hours (initial mitigation/owner assignment), High = 5 business days to triage and schedule fix, Medium = 30 days for planned remediation or compensating controls. Exceptions handled via documented risk-acceptance flow.
- Owners: Security ops (kimberly_park) coordinates triage and ticketing; Engineering on-call teams own fixes; Customer Success (monica_patel) will coordinate communications for audit requests.

I'm attaching a remediation roadmap (remediation-roadmap.xlsx) and a triage matrix (triage-matrix.csv) for your reviewers. If you need a signed attestation PDF, I can generate that and have kimberly sign it before EOD.

Attachments: scan_snapshot-20260701.csv; soc2-extract-redwood.pdf; remediation-roadmap.xlsx

Best,

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 13:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM snapshot + 48-hour CVE closure pledge for SOC2 review (internal)

Diego / Monica — adding detail for the attestation and operational steps we'll commit to in writing for FinBridge: 

1) Triage & owner assignment process:
   - Incoming scanner results and external reports funnel into our Security Ops queue (PagerDuty + Jira).
   - For any finding marked Critical (CVSS >= 9 or exploit-known + production exposure) a triage lead is assigned within 1 hour and an owner is assigned within 48 hours. Owner assignment creates a remediation ticket and sets expected remediation ETA.

2) SLA mapping (to include verbatim in attestation):
   - Critical: Initial mitigation/owner assignment within 48 hours; emergency remediation process engaged; weekly status updates until closure.
   - High: Triage complete and remediation scheduled within 5 business days.
   - Medium: Mitigation plan scheduled within 30 calendar days; tracked in backlog.

3) Evidence & audit artifacts we will deliver:
   - Scan export (attached) with timestamps and current state.
   - Ticket references for each open critical/high finding (include Jira IDs in attestation).
   - Signed attestation on company letterhead from Security Ops.

4) Exceptions and risk acceptance:
   - Any exception that exceeds the SLA requires documented risk acceptance signed by Engineering manager + Security Ops. We will include any active exceptions for FinBridge in the attestation.

I'll prepare the signed attestation PDF once Diego gives the OK. I'm attaching the triage-matrix.csv with our severity rules.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Security Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

1) Vulnerability scan snapshot provided: scan_snapshot-20260701.csv (attached). This export reflects the canonical state of findings as of 2026-07-01T07:45:00Z.

3) Owners: Security Operations (kimberly_park@redwood.ai) coordinates triage and evidence exports; engineering teams own code/infra fixes.
4) Exceptions: Any active exceptions are documented and will be included in the evidence packet.

We commit to providing Jira ticket references for all Critical findings within the next business day and will provide a signed PDF attestation if required for your SOC2 binder.
